title: 機翼扭轉與氣動彈性
summary: 以彎扭耦合教學翼比較氣動力、剛性與動態模態；靜態撓度、扭角及固有頻率各有用途，不能宣稱已求得真機顫振邊界。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use a bending/torsion teaching wing to compare aerodynamic load, stiffness and modes; static deflection, twist and frequency have different uses and do not establish an aircraft flutter boundary. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 氣動負載來源：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Origin of aerodynamic load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 氣動負載來源 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Origin of aerodynamic load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
steps.instructionEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼扭轉與氣動彈性實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Wing twist and aeroelasticity: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, S=2 m² and CL=0.6. Formula L=ρV²SCL/2 gives 648 N. Conditions: Low-speed fixed-CL model, excluding stall and three-dimensional separation.
steps.failure: 使用濕面積取代參考翼面積會使係數不可比；分離後不能保持線性CL。
steps.failureEn: Using wetted area instead of reference wing area breaks coefficient comparisons; CL cannot remain linear after separation.
steps.check: 扣除支架皮重，以同一面積正規化力天平讀值，分別記錄迎角上掃與下掃。
steps.checkEn: Subtract support tare, normalize balance forces with one area definition, and record increasing and decreasing incidence separately.

knowledge.text: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
knowledge.textEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把CL改成0.8；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 648 改為 864 N。在算式區重算並記下對「氣動負載來源」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only CL to 0.8, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 648 to 864 N. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Origin of aerodynamic load, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「機翼扭轉與氣動彈性」的「氣動負載來源：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Origin of aerodynamic load: Mechanism and observation” in “Wing twist and aeroelasticity”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 負載中心的力臂：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moment arm of the load centre: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 負載中心的力臂 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moment arm of the load centre and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分布升力經翼盒傳到翼根；相同總力若作用中心更外移，根部彎矩也會增加。
steps.instructionEn: Distributed lift passes through the wing box to the root; moving the centre of force outward increases root moment even at equal total force.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非機翼扭轉與氣動彈性實際性能或製程：等效半翼力F=5000 N，力臂a=2 m。式 M=Fa，基準結果 10000 N·m。適用條件：單一靜態等效力，未包括燃油、引擎與動態慣性分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Wing twist and aeroelasticity: Equivalent half-wing force F=5000 N and arm a=2 m. Formula M=Fa gives 10000 N·m. Conditions: One equivalent static force, excluding distributed fuel, engine and dynamic inertia effects.
steps.failure: 忽略向下的設備重量或錯誤力臂，會使根部彎矩與測值不合。
steps.failureEn: Omitted downward equipment weight or a wrong arm causes disagreement with measured root moment.
steps.check: 沿翼展標出每一載荷方向，分段累積剪力與彎矩並核對根部平衡。
steps.checkEn: Mark load directions along the span, accumulate shear and moment by segment, and check root equilibrium.
